hooks.name: TechLead No Source Grep
hooks.description: Hard-blocks the TechLead orchestrator from grepping inside src/** or running unconstrained whole-repo searches. Only .kiro/**, docs/**, and explicit non-src paths are allowed.

action.command: pwsh -NoProfile -Command "$json = $input | Out-String | ConvertFrom-Json; $inc = [string]$json.tool_input.includePattern; $blocked = ($inc -eq '' -or $inc -match '^\*\*' -or $inc -match 'src[/\\]'); if ($blocked) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('BLOCKED: TechLead may not grep src/** or run unconstrained searches. Scope to .kiro/** or docs/**, or delegate to a subagent.'); exit 2 }; exit 0"
